integrity_statement: All claims have explicit graph assumptions and mathematical proof; finite computation is marked corroborative; no external or independent validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: The graph concerns coherent monotone-path polytopes, not the larger graph of all monotone paths.
The auxiliary vertex-degree law is on the completed ternary Cartesian grid; the count concerns its deleted-center signohedral graph.
Integer checks through four ternary coordinates corroborate but do not replace the all-dimensional proof.
An equivalent vertex-deleted Cartesian-grid enumeration under unrelated terminology remains a literature-search risk.
title: Exact spanning-tree complexity and a two-binomial degree law for signohedral flip graphs
